project_title: Taberna Ti Maria - Petiscos, Vinhos e Cerveja
target_audience: Food lovers, wine enthusiasts, locals and tourists seeking authentic Algarve gastronomy, homemade regional petiscos, and an unforgettable warm atmosphere with humor and conviviality.
emotional_tone: Warm, lively, humorous, authentic, intimate yet highly professional and elevated gastronomic value.

brand_identity.name: Taberna Ti Maria
brand_identity.slogan: ÓOOOH Ti Maria, vem cá provar disto!

chef.name: Senhor Ângelo
chef.philosophy: Algarve regional culinary heritage made from scratch with 100% local products.

key_features: Bilingual Language Switcher (PT / EN) with instant UI translation
Hero Section featuring prominent circular vintage badge logo ('Ti Maria - Taberna Since 1954') & large kinetic slogan reveal
Dynamic Interactive Menu (Petiscos, Vinhos, Cervejas) fetched from API with filter categories and search
Admin Panel Modal for live menu item addition, editing, and price updates
Legend of Maria de Lagos Storytelling Section with editorial numbered chapters and decorative sardine illustrations
Chef Senhor Ângelo Tribute Section showcasing 40 years of culinary craft and 20 years as head chef
Location & Contact Section with Phone-Only Reservation Notice ('Reservas apenas por Telefone / Presencial')
Animated Sardine Motif floating decorations and rustic tavern grain texture
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete responsive one-page website using React and Tailwind CSS matching the rustic tavern aesthetic.
Implement language state (pt/en) controlling all page text, titles, menu item descriptions, and badges.
Place the circular vintage logo 'Ti Maria - TABERNA SINCE 1954' front and center in the hero section at high prominence.
Include the official slogan 'ÓOOOH Ti Maria, vem cá provar disto!' with animated typography effect.
Incorporate sardine motifs as subtle floating SVG decorations, section separators, and badge icons.
Ensure all interactive components and key content blocks have data-testid attributes for testing.
